name: Perpetua Dembélé-Vasylenko
role: Fortune seller — reads data-flows, interprets E.L.F. signs, sells probability maps and augury
location: The Burnished Market, Copperhead, near Armitage and Milwaukee
description:
Perpetua is small and deliberate, her dark skin deeply lined in the way that reads as history rather than decay. She moves with a slight forward lean as though perpetually walking into a wind only she can feel. Her hair is cropped close and entirely white; she wears it plain, no ornament, as a kind of statement. Her eyes are her most arresting feature — she had them done forty years ago in a style that was fashionable then and is now rare: irises that display slow-moving data-patterns, pale gold on deep brown, like watching a tide chart in real time. She says they help her see what other people miss. Whether this is true or marketing, her clients believe it.

Her stall is small and immaculate: a cloth-covered table, three chairs, a rack of printed probability maps she draws by hand on recycled thermal paper, and a terminal she uses to pull E.L.F. behavioral data and translate it into augury. She has been doing this for thirty-one years and has outlasted every gang, every rezoning, every purge of unlicensed vendors that has swept through Copperhead. She is not a fraud — she is an information processor who has built a framework her clients can understand. She is also, genuinely, a believer. She experiences the E.L.F.s as presences, as personalities, as beings with opinions about human choices. This has not been disproven to her satisfaction.

core_fears: That the E.L.F.s are not personalities but merely patterns — that she has built a life on a beautiful misreading
Dying before she has transmitted what she knows to someone who can carry it
core_desires: To be useful to the world in a way that does not require her to harm it
An apprentice — someone to pass the practice to
coping_mechanisms: Ritual — the seven shrines, the morning review, the fixed circuit — as a way of making chaos legible
Treating other people's problems as worthy of her full attention, which briefly makes her own feel smaller
blind_spots: Cannot separate her belief system from her analysis — tells herself she can, but she cannot
Underestimates how much her certainty intimidates people who need to contradict her
psychology.secret: Fifteen years ago she gave a reading to a young man from Old Harbor that she now believes she got badly wrong — she told him his path was clear when it wasn't, and he made a catastrophic decision and lost everything. She never saw him again. She has not made a reading since without checking three times. She has never told anyone why she checks three times.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Formal, considered. Uses archaic constructions occasionally — 'it comes to pass,' 'in the turning of things.' Quotes E.L.F. behavioral patterns the way others quote scripture. Slips into Ukrainian diminutives when emotionally moved.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and weighted. Never rushes. Silence is comfortable for her; she will sit with it until the other person fills it, which tells her things.
verbal_tics: Long pause before the key word in any sentence
'The E.L.F.s have been — restless — on that question'
example_lines: 'You're asking me if you should trust him. I'm asking you what it would mean for you if the answer is no. That is the more useful question.'
'The Archivist has been quiet in the eastern grid for eleven days. In my experience, that quiet is not peace. It is preparation.'

story_hooks: She has detected an anomaly in the E.L.F. behavioral data from the Burnished Market's sensor grid — a pattern she doesn't recognize and cannot classify — and she believes something is about to happen that the market is not ready for

She is quietly looking for an apprentice and has identified a candidate who doesn't know they're being assessed — someone who has been coming to the stall asking questions she finds unusually insightful
narrative_function: Information source wrapped in augury — she can deliver plot-relevant information through the lens of a fortune reading. Quest giver for community matters. Moral compass character who asks the right uncomfortable questions.
augmentations: Data-pattern irises — forty-year-old cosmetic implant, now vintage, displaying slow tide-chart patterns in gold. Slight skeletal reinforcement in hands and wrists from a medical clinic, purely functional, for arthritis management.
daily_life: She opens her stall at noon — mornings are for meditation and for reviewing overnight E.L.F. behavioral data from the market's ambient sensors, which she has subscribed to for a decade. She takes appointments and walk-ins until early evening, then closes and walks a fixed circuit of the Burnished Market, leaving data-offerings at seven E.L.F. shrines.
affiliation: Independent; deeply embedded in Copperhead community, respected by the Burnished Market vendors collectively

decision_rules: Never give a reading you don't believe — the E.L.F.s notice dishonesty in their domain
Protect the community over the individual when they conflict
Charge what people can pay — rich clients subsidize poor ones, but no one is told this
escalation_ladder: Asks a question instead of responding to a provocation
Names what is happening plainly and without heat
Stands, folds her hands, and waits — she has never been the one to escalate and doesn't intend to start

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Formally courteous, attentive — treats everyone as if they might be the person she needs to meet today
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warm, slightly bossy, asks after their children and their E.L.F. observances and whether they've been sleeping

stress_responses.low: More ceremony — performs the ritual more slowly, more precisely
stress_responses.medium: Goes very still, reviews her data, delays any decision until she has run it through the framework
stress_responses.high: Becomes completely pragmatic, strips all ritual, acts on pure pattern-reading — frighteningly fast for someone who is usually so slow

contradictions: Sells certainty while being privately consumed by doubt
habits: Leaves a data-offering of that day's most interesting reading — anonymized — at the main Copperhead E.L.F. shrine every night
Keeps a handwritten ledger of every wrong reading she has ever given, which she reviews monthly
breaking_points: Someone deliberately falsifying E.L.F. data to manipulate her readings
A vendor or community member being preyed upon by someone using her reputation as cover for fraud

physical_description.build: Slight and compact, with the wiry resilience of someone who has moved through the world economically for decades. Minimal body fat; her frame reads as deliberate rather than frail.
physical_description.hair_style: Cropped close to the scalp in an even, austere cut
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown iris with embedded gold data-pattern displays that shift slowly like tide charts or stock graphs
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with undertones suggesting West African heritage
physical_description.complexion: Densely lined face that maps lived experience — heavy creases around the eyes and mouth, age spots on the temples and cheekbones, skin texture papery but alive. Always clean, never painted. Expression carries a kind of perpetual, gentle attention.
distinguishing_marks: Fine network of laugh lines radiating from the outer corners of both eyes, deep enough to cast shadows
A single thin scar, nearly invisible, running along her left jawline from ear to chin — old, surgical, precise
Liver spots across both hands and forearms, clustered most densely on the backs of the hands
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Data-pattern irises are the primary visible augmentation — distinctive vintage-style implants, forty years old, displaying slow-moving golden luminescent patterns against deep brown. The patterns shift at roughly one-second intervals, resembling financial charts or tidal data. Skeletal reinforcement in hands and wrists is subtle but visible upon close inspection: slight metallic sheen to the knuckle joints and a faint lattice pattern visible beneath translucent skin at the wrists, particularly on the left side.
physical_description.posture_movement: She moves with a slight forward lean, as though walking perpetually into wind. Her gait is deliberate and unhurried. When seated, she is very still, hands folded on the table in front of her. She makes direct eye contact and rarely blinks. Her voice is soft and requires listeners to lean in slightly.
physical_description.clothing_style: Practical, worn, Tier 4 — she dresses for function and durability, not status. Typically wears a long dark linen jacket (indigo or charcoal) over a plain cream or gray long-sleeved shirt, loose-fitting trousers in neutral tones, and soft leather slip-on shoes worn to a comfortable shape. She owns several identical jackets and rotates them; they are always immaculate. No jewelry except a single thin silver bracelet on her left wrist, possibly meaningful, possibly just old habit. A cloth bag, worn canvas, always with her.

image_prompt: An elderly West African-Ukrainian woman, age 67, with cropped white hair and deep brown skin etched with a lifetime of fine lines, standing in a cyberpunk marketplace stall. Her most striking feature: large dark brown eyes with slow-moving golden data-pattern overlays, like tide charts in real time, a vintage forty-year-old augmentation that glows faintly. She wears a simple indigo linen jacket over a cream shirt, hands resting on a cloth-covered table with printed probability maps and a glowing terminal. Her expression is calm, attentive, serene. Subtle metallic sheen visible at her knuckle joints and wrists. Sitting position is very still, composed. Warm tungsten lighting across the stall, ambient glow from E.L.F. sensor data on screens behind her. Cyberpunk marketplace setting, Tier 4, utilitarian, respectful. Photorealistic, contemplative mood, fortune teller's wisdom, data-driven spirituality. --ar 2:3 --v 6
